reading: The UK government and the EU are expected to publish two treaty texts on Thursday, following agreements reached the previous week as part of a broader deal.
UK legislation intended to enact most of the deal is due to appear alongside the treaty texts.

According to the BBC, were either party to terminate the agreement within the first ten years, it would have to pay to re-establish border infrastructure that is to be substantially reduced under the deal.
Opposition leader Kemi Badenoch and Reform UK's Nigel Farage have indicated that they would refuse to make such payments.
The broader deal covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.
Britain's aviation and maritime industries would also be affected by alignment with EU emissions schemes.
Food businesses exporting to the EU are expected to be major beneficiaries of fewer administrative requirements and the dismantling of border facilities.
An internal analysis projects a 16% increase in agricultural exports, a forecast rather than an established gain.
Industry and government hope that savings for food producers and sellers will reach consumers, although shoppers may see no discernible reduction at the checkout.
Industry insiders privately told the BBC that the global economy has too many moving parts to make the outcome clear, particularly amid the energy price shock resulting from war in the Middle East.
The treaty text is also expected to specify how the UK will observe and help shape relevant EU rules without having a vote on them.
The accompanying legislation is expected to detail plans to align UK and EU law through secondary legislation, meaning rules made under powers granted by an existing Act.

vocabulary.definition: To give a policy or agreement legal effect by passing legislation.
To formally bring an agreement to an end, with any consequences its terms require.
To restore something that previously existed after it has been removed or reduced.
A system in which participants buy and sell allowances permitting specified quantities of greenhouse gas emissions.
The process or state of bringing rules or systems into agreement so that they operate consistently.
People or organisations that gain an advantage from a particular arrangement or change.
The process of taking facilities apart and removing them from use.
Interacting factors that can change independently, making an overall outcome difficult to predict.
To comply with a rule or requirement, rather than merely watch what happens.
Rules made using authority granted by an existing Act, rather than by passing a new Act.

entries.ja: 法律を制定することで、政策や合意に法的な効力を持たせること。
entries.ko: 법률을 제정하여 정책이나 합의에 법적 효력을 부여하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过制定法律，使政策或协议具有法律效力。
entries.es: Dar efecto legal a una política o un acuerdo mediante la aprobación de legislación.
entries.pt-BR: Dar efeito legal a uma política ou a um acordo por meio da aprovação de legislação.
entries.fr: Donner un effet juridique à une politique ou à un accord en adoptant des dispositions législatives.
entries.de: Einer politischen Maßnahme oder einer Vereinbarung durch die Verabschiedung von Gesetzen rechtliche Wirkung verleihen.

entries.ja: 合意を正式に終了させ、その条項で定められた結果があれば、それに伴う責任を負うこと。
entries.ko: 합의를 공식적으로 끝내고, 그 조항에 따라 발생하는 결과가 있으면 이를 감수하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 正式终止协议，并承担协议条款所规定的相应后果。
entries.es: Poner fin formalmente a un acuerdo, con las consecuencias que exijan sus condiciones.
entries.pt-BR: Encerrar formalmente um acordo, com as consequências exigidas por seus termos.
entries.fr: Mettre officiellement fin à un accord, avec les conséquences prévues par ses dispositions.
entries.de: Eine Vereinbarung formell beenden, mit allen Folgen, die ihre Bestimmungen vorsehen.

entries.ja: 撤去または縮小されたものを、以前存在していた状態に戻すこと。
entries.ko: 이전에 존재했으나 제거되거나 축소된 것을 복구하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 将原先存在、后来被移除或缩减的事物恢复起来。
entries.es: Restablecer algo que existía anteriormente después de que se haya eliminado o reducido.
entries.pt-BR: Restabelecer algo que existia antes, depois de ter sido removido ou reduzido.
entries.fr: Rétablir quelque chose qui existait auparavant, après sa suppression ou sa réduction.
entries.de: Etwas, das früher bestand, nach seiner Entfernung oder Verringerung wiederherstellen.

entries.ja: 温室効果ガスを決められた量だけ排出することを認める排出枠を、参加者が売買する制度。
entries.ko: 참여자들이 정해진 양의 온실가스를 배출할 수 있는 배출권을 사고파는 제도.
entries.zh-Hans: 参与者买卖温室气体排放配额的制度，每份配额允许排放规定数量的温室气体。
entries.es: Sistema en el que los participantes compran y venden permisos que autorizan la emisión de cantidades determinadas de gases de efecto invernadero.
entries.pt-BR: Sistema em que os participantes compram e vendem permissões para emitir quantidades determinadas de gases de efeito estufa.
entries.fr: Système dans lequel les participants achètent et vendent des quotas autorisant l’émission de quantités déterminées de gaz à effet de serre.
entries.de: Ein System, in dem die Beteiligten Berechtigungen kaufen und verkaufen, die den Ausstoß festgelegter Mengen an Treibhausgasen erlauben.

entries.ja: 規則や制度が一貫して機能するように互いに整合させる過程、または整合している状態。
entries.ko: 규칙이나 제도가 일관되게 작동하도록 서로 맞추는 과정 또는 그렇게 맞춰진 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 使规则或制度相互协调、从而一致运行的过程或状态。
entries.es: Proceso de armonizar normas o sistemas para que funcionen de manera coherente entre sí, o estado resultante de ese proceso.
entries.pt-BR: Processo ou estado de harmonização de regras ou sistemas para que funcionem de maneira coerente entre si.
entries.fr: Processus consistant à mettre des règles ou des systèmes en accord pour qu’ils fonctionnent de manière cohérente, ou état qui en résulte.
entries.de: Der Vorgang oder Zustand der Abstimmung von Regeln oder Systemen, sodass sie in Einklang miteinander funktionieren.

entries.ja: 特定の取り決めや変化によって利益を得る人々や組織。
entries.ko: 특정한 합의나 변화로 이익을 얻는 사람이나 조직.
entries.zh-Hans: 从某项安排或变化中获益的个人或组织。
entries.es: Personas u organizaciones que obtienen una ventaja de un acuerdo o cambio concreto.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas ou organizações que obtêm uma vantagem com determinado acordo ou mudança.
entries.fr: Personnes ou organisations qui tirent un avantage d’un arrangement ou d’un changement particulier.
entries.de: Personen oder Organisationen, die aus einer bestimmten Regelung oder Veränderung einen Vorteil ziehen.

entries.ja: 施設を解体し、使用をやめる過程。
entries.ko: 시설을 해체하고 더 이상 사용하지 않도록 하는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 将设施拆解并停止使用的过程。
entries.es: Proceso de desmontar instalaciones y dejar de utilizarlas.
entries.pt-BR: Processo de desmontar instalações e retirá-las de uso.
entries.fr: Processus consistant à démonter des installations et à les retirer du service.
entries.de: Der Vorgang, bei dem Einrichtungen zerlegt und außer Betrieb genommen werden.

entries.ja: 互いに影響し合う一方で、それぞれ独立して変化する可能性があり、全体の結果を予測しにくくする要因。
entries.ko: 각각 독립적으로 변할 수 있으면서 서로 영향을 주어 전체 결과를 예측하기 어렵게 만드는 요인들.
entries.zh-Hans: 相互影响、又能各自独立变化，使整体结果难以预测的因素。
entries.es: Factores que interactúan y pueden cambiar de forma independiente, lo que dificulta predecir el resultado global.
entries.pt-BR: Fatores que interagem e podem mudar de forma independente, dificultando a previsão do resultado geral.
entries.fr: Facteurs qui interagissent et peuvent évoluer indépendamment les uns des autres, ce qui rend le résultat global difficile à prévoir.
entries.de: Faktoren, die sich gegenseitig beeinflussen und unabhängig voneinander verändern können, wodurch das Gesamtergebnis schwer vorherzusagen ist.

entries.ja: 単に成り行きを見守るのではなく、規則や要件に従うこと。
entries.ko: 단순히 일어나는 일을 지켜보는 것이 아니라 규칙이나 요구 사항을 준수하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 遵守规则或要求，而不只是观察所发生的事情。
entries.es: Cumplir una norma o un requisito, en lugar de limitarse a mirar lo que ocurre.
entries.pt-BR: Cumprir uma regra ou exigência, em vez de apenas observar o que acontece.
entries.fr: Respecter une règle ou une exigence, plutôt que simplement regarder ce qui se passe.
entries.de: Eine Regel oder Vorgabe einhalten, anstatt lediglich zu beobachten, was geschieht.

entries.ja: 新たな法律を制定するのではなく、既存の法律によって与えられた権限に基づいて定められる規則。
entries.ko: 새로운 법률을 제정하는 대신 기존 법률이 부여한 권한에 따라 만드는 규칙.
entries.zh-Hans: 依据现有法律授予的权限制定的规则，而非通过制定新法律来确立的规则。
entries.es: Normas establecidas mediante la autoridad otorgada por una ley existente, y no mediante la aprobación de una nueva ley.
entries.pt-BR: Regras criadas com base na autoridade concedida por uma lei existente, e não pela aprovação de uma nova lei.
entries.fr: Règles établies en vertu des pouvoirs accordés par une loi existante, plutôt que par l’adoption d’une nouvelle loi.
entries.de: Regeln, die auf Grundlage einer durch ein bestehendes Gesetz erteilten Befugnis erlassen werden, statt durch die Verabschiedung eines neuen Gesetzes.
